description: This file implements functions related to default PUSCH (Physical Uplink Shared Channel) time domain allocation in a 5G NR (New Radio) scheduler, including table definitions and retrieval functions based on configuration parameters.

methods.name: s_and_len
methods.description: Helper function to construct an ofdm_symbol_range with start and length.

methods.name: pusch_default_time_allocation_default_A_get_j
methods.description: Returns the value j for a given subcarrier spacing, based on TS38.214 Table 6.1.2.1.1-4.

methods.name: pusch_default_time_allocations_default_A_table
methods.description: Returns the default PUSCH time domain resource allocation table for given cyclic prefix and subcarrier spacing.

methods.name: pusch_default_time_allocation_default_A_get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific row from the default allocation table based on parameters.

methods.name: get_c_rnti_pusch_time_domain_list
methods.description: Provides the list of PUSCH time domain allocations based on search space configuration and BWP parameters.
